title: gh-clean-merged configuration
description: Optional configuration for the gh-clean-merged extension. A global file lives under the user's config directory, a local one at the root of a repository; the local file wins, except for protected patterns which add up, and command line flags win over both.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation.

base.description: Base branch that branches with no pull request are compared against. Defaults to the repository default branch.

remote.description: Remote whose branches count as shared work.

protected.description: Branch names or globs that must never be deleted. Values from the global and local files add up.

keepClosed.description: Keep branches whose pull request was closed without merging, instead of deleting them along with the merged ones.

noFetch.description: Skip `git fetch --prune` and use the refs already on disk.

dryRun.description: List what would be deleted and exit.

verbose.description: Also list the branches that are kept, with the reason.

color.description: Colour output. `auto` turns colour off when the output is piped, under TERM=dumb and under NO_COLOR.
